frames.legacy_angle: atan(py_A/pz_A); retained only to reproduce raw-component plots

truth.generated_signal: status=1; 0<barcode<200000; |pdg|=13 for muon DSIDs, |pdg|=11 for Aprime DSIDs
truth.fiducial: production vertex radius<100 mm; valid SiHit mean position in stations 1,2,3, each radius<100 mm
truth.H18: at least 18 SiHits with the signal barcode in stations 1,2,3 combined
truth.momentum_reference: HepMC production vertex; never labelled same-sensor local truth
truth.station_direction_reference: average direction from the actual SiHit start/end positions transformed by transformHit; station average is not a fixed plane
truth.local_momentum_supplement: FaserSctSensorSD optional FASER_SCT_LOCAL_TRUTH_FILE sidecar records pre/post G4 momentum. Re-simulation needs input BeamTruthEvent and random/geometry/conditions provenance. G4 continuation vertices are separately retained snapshots.

track_selections.Good95: chi2/ndof<25; distinct station/layer count>=7; ndof+5>=12; maximum fitted-state transverse radius<95 mm
track_selections.one_Good95: exactly one final track passing Good95 in the event
track_selections.Alma_historical: PDF specifies fiducial truth, r_atMaxRadius<100 mm, exactly one Good Track. Historical public Ntuple source uses Good95. Exact Twiki/analysis selection remains a reproduction difference until original selection is recovered.

matching.basis: SDO contributions of measured cluster RDO identifiers
matching.ties: majority hit count, then deterministic barcode order; flag shared/ambiguous cases
matching.best_candidate: majority hit count, number of measurements, chi2, stable candidate ID; charge and momentum excluded

anomalies.invalid: missing/NaN/qop=0 counted separately; never replaced by 999999

primary_pilot.material: current faser_reco default unrotated alma9 map; historical rotated and strictly rotated current maps are separate controls
primary_pilot.concurrency: one serial event slot per process; independent HTCondor shards
